tools.name: calculate_curvature
tools.description: Calculates how much of a distant target the Earth's curvature hides, from the surface distance, the observer's eye height, the target's height and an assumed refraction coefficient. Returns the hidden and visible height, the tangent-plane drop, the horizon distance and dip, the maximum mutual sight-

tools.name: get_horizon_distance
tools.description: Gives the distance to the horizon from an eye height above a smooth sphere, and how far a taller object such as a mast stays in straight sight. Returns the observer's horizon distance, the range added by the target height and the maximum shared sightline.

tools.name: compare_flat_map_distance
tools.description: Compares the distance between two cities on a north-polar flat-Earth map with their great-circle distance over a sphere. Returns both distances and the factor by which the map stretches or shrinks the pair.

tools.name: get_flight_distance
tools.description: Calculates the great-circle distance between two places in kilometres, miles and nautical miles, with the initial and final compass bearings. Each end is one of the website's 20 cities or a latitude and longitude.

tools.name: get_sun_position
tools.description: Calculates the Sun's altitude and compass bearing at a place, date and UTC time, with the shadow of a 1 m upright and the day's sunrise and sunset in UTC. A place is one of the website's 20 cities or a latitude and longitude; without a date and time the result is for the current moment.

tools.name: get_daylight_hours
tools.description: Calculates the length of daylight at a place on a date, with sunrise and sunset in UTC, for the UTC day from midnight to midnight. A place is one of the website's 20 cities or a latitude with an optional longitude.

tools.name: compare_true_size
tools.description: Shows how much a Mercator map distorts a country's area, from its real area and the latitude it is drawn at. Returns the real area, the area multiplier at the country's own latitude and at a chosen latitude, and the size it appears at each. Covers the nine countries and regions in the website's size

tools.name: find_claims
tools.description: Searches the website's tested claims and flat-earth investigations, or returns one by id. Each result gives the claim, the verdict, the key evidence and the link to its page; an empty query lists all of them.
